song_craft: Voice: grove-vibhAva couplets (+1 monostich thesis). Arc: shine-for-Kama (v10, thesis) -> chief-by-sprouts (v11) -> kuTaja mocked/bowed (v12) -> nIpa released (v13) -> bee kisses (v14) -> dust blinds luminaries (v15) -> drunk peacocks + kunda kept (v16, coverage repaired) -> weapon-cloud resounds (v17) -> roar-falls-wonder (v18). Beauty as cause, not decoration.
